title: CIA offer to head an ELF research department, brought by Bob Beck

tellings.quote: had been approached by the CIA to head up a ELF research uh department basically.

plain: A researcher on Jesse Michels's podcast, working from handwritten legal pad notes left by an inventor and parapsychology researcher named Andrija Puharich, says that in the late 1970s a scientist named Bob Beck came to Puharich's house. According to the researcher, Beck said the CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency, had approached him to head a department researching ELF, meaning extremely low frequency radio waves. If true, it would show the agency taking an interest in fringe science that some link to mind and contact research.
